label: TP
reason: User input flows through param -> doSomething() -> escapeHtml() -> bar -> response.getWriter().format(). While escapeHtml() sanitizes HTML entities, it does not protect against format string vulnerabilities where %n, %s, or other format specifiers in user input could cause unintended behavior or bypass protections. The tainted variable reaches a writable sink (getWriter().format()) without effective mitigation.

evidence.note: Data flow from user input through escapeHtml() to format() sink
